policies.text: If the country of citizenship of something is X, and the head of government of X is Y, then the head of government of the country of citizenship of that thing is Y.
If the country of citizenship of something is X, and the head of state of X is Y, then the head of state of the country of citizenship of that thing is Y.
If the country of origin of the manufacturer of something is X, and the head of government of X is Y, then the head of government of the country of origin of the manufacturer of that thing is Y.
If the country of origin of the manufacturer of something is X, and the head of state of X is Y, then the head of state of the country of origin of the manufacturer of that thing is Y.

If the headquarters location of the original broadcaster of something is X, and the head of government of X is Y, then the head of government of the headquarters location of the original broadcaster of that thing is Y.
